micro1 MissionReport

cohort4.benchmark.missionreport

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual main creator-report and complete pinned sample-card source read establishes one MissionReport benchmark family:20reporting tasks; the public5task sample is explicitly25percent of that family, not a separate dataset family. Methods specify expert-created assignments/working files/templates/rubrics, same OpenCode solver setup, penalized criterion scoring and agentic judging. Original five exact qualified observations have separate real author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts. Private15tasks, actual Word attachments, expert credentials, judge calibration and detailed example/payload outputs remain unaudited. Source-specific CC-BY4.0 sample declaration and explicit nonoperational/no-government-endorsement limits stay attached. Full_source means available primary methodological source content, not an audit of government operations or reproduction of the private benchmark.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

micro1 MissionReport · documents: Task reward is positive criterion points minus triggered penalties divided by possible positive points, clamped to 0–1; a missing/corrupt/empty report scores zero. The agentic judge sees the submitted Word document and expert report.

candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.missionreport.penalty-and-judge-protocol

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The judge does not see source files, point weights or grading guidance. A gold report scoring 100% is a self-check, not independent judge reliability.
